newsitem.title: USA: FX Energy plugs Nevada wildcat well.
newsitem.headline: FX Energy plugs Nevada wildcat well.

text.p: FX Energy Inc said Wednesday it plugged the Cobb Creek federal 11-1 well after a strong water flow was encountered at 959 feet.
The company said drilling operations on the Lincoln County, Nev., well began October 1. The Cobb Creek 11-1 was a rank wildcat well designed to test a large subsurface anticlinal structure.
The top of the target structure was estimated to lie at about 1,800 feet, and drilling and testing were estimated at 30 days, FX said.

The anticipated principal reservoir, a Devonian Guilmette, was penetrated at a shallower depth than expected, indicating that the entire upper-paleozoic section of the structure was missing. Since no internal seals are known within the Guilmette which would provide a trap for hydrocarbons, additional drilling below the water zone was not warranted, the company explained.
